name: VDC/IE (vinCRIStine, DOXOrubicin, Cyclophosphamide alternating with Ifosfamide, Etoposide) for Ewing Sarcoma

biomarkers.note: EWSR1 (or variant FET-family) gene rearrangement is diagnostic of Ewing sarcoma but does not gate this cytotoxic regimen; VDC/IE is not molecular-biomarker-restricted. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Bone Cancer v1.2027, Ewing Sarcoma Systemic Therapy (category 1).

lineOfTherapy: first-line (primary neoadjuvant/adjuvant) multiagent therapy for Ewing sarcoma; category 1, delivered as interval-compressed alternating cycles

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: Ewing sarcoma requiring first-line multiagent chemotherapy
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v1.2027, Ewing Sarcoma Systemic Therapy (EW): VDC-IE category 1, line 1324 to 1327

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: adequate cardiac function (anthracycline), renal function and adequate urothelial protection (ifosfamide/cyclophosphamide), and marrow reserve for interval-compressed dosing
eligibilityCriteria.locator: Ewing sarcoma chapter (interval-compressed VDC/IE), line 221819 to 221823

drugs.name: vinCRIStine

provenance.locator: Ewing Sarcoma Systemic Therapy (EW): VDC-IE = Vincristine/Doxorubicin/Cyclophosphamide/Mesna alternating with Ifosfamide/Mesna/Etoposide, category 1 (line 1324 to 1327)

drugs.notes: vinCRIStine is the V of the VDC arm; the milligram dose is NOT printed in the provided sources, so basis, dosePerUnit, and unit are VERIFY. A conventional per-dose cap of 2 mg is applied (caps.perDose = 2; standard ISMP-aligned vincristine ceiling, not a value from the source table). ISMP tall-man applied (vinCRIStine). NEVER give intrathecally (fatal); IV only.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin

provenance.locator: Ewing Sarcoma Systemic Therapy (EW): VDC-IE includes Doxorubicin, category 1 (line 1324 to 1327)

drugs.notes: DOXOrubicin is the D of the VDC arm; the milligram dose is NOT printed in the provided sources, so basis, dosePerUnit, and unit are VERIFY. The anthracycline cumulative lifetime cap (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2) is the conventional anthracycline ceiling and is retained as a safety guard; dexrazoxane cardioprotection may be considered per protocol as the ceiling is approached. ISMP tall-man applied (DOXOrubicin).

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide

provenance.locator: Ewing Sarcoma Systemic Therapy (EW): VDC-IE includes Cyclophosphamide/Mesna, category 1 (line 1324 to 1327)

drugs.notes: Cyclophosphamide is the C of the VDC arm; the milligram dose is NOT printed in the provided sources, so basis, dosePerUnit, and unit are VERIFY. Mesna uroprotection is mandatory with cyclophosphamide at these doses (see supportiveCare).

drugs.name: Ifosfamide

provenance.locator: Ewing Sarcoma Systemic Therapy (EW): VDC-IE includes the alternating Ifosfamide/Mesna/Etoposide (IE) arm, category 1 (line 1324 to 1327)

drugs.notes: Ifosfamide is the I of the alternating IE arm (given on the cycles that alternate with VDC); the milligram dose and multi-day schedule are NOT printed in the provided sources, so basis, dosePerUnit, and unit are VERIFY. Mesna uroprotection is MANDATORY with ifosfamide (hemorrhagic cystitis) and ifosfamide encephalopathy must be monitored (see supportiveCare).

drugs.name: Etoposide

provenance.locator: Ewing Sarcoma Systemic Therapy (EW): VDC-IE includes Etoposide in the alternating IE arm, category 1 (line 1324 to 1327)

drugs.notes: Etoposide is the E of the alternating IE arm; the milligram dose and multi-day schedule are NOT printed in the provided sources, so basis, dosePerUnit, and unit are VERIFY.

premedications.name: Mesna uroprotection
premedications.notes: give with cyclophosphamide (VDC arm) and with ifosfamide (IE arm) for urothelial protection

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: VDC/IE is highly emetogenic; give guideline-tier prophylaxis

supportiveCare: interval compression: VDC and IE cycles alternate every 2 weeks (interval-compressed) as the standard approach; mandatory G-CSF support between cycles (DeVita 12th ed., line 221819 to 221823).
mesna uroprotection with both the cyclophosphamide (VDC) and ifosfamide (IE) cycles; monitor for hemorrhagic cystitis.
ifosfamide neurotoxicity: monitor for encephalopathy; methylene blue per protocol if it occurs.
anthracycline: cumulative DOXOrubicin tracking (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2) and baseline/periodic LVEF.
vinCRIStine 2 mg per-dose cap; IV only, NEVER intrathecal.
the per-drug milligram doses, multi-day schedules, and total cycle count are VERIFY (not printed in the provided sources) and must be resolved from a cited dosing source before activation.

monitoring: CBC before each interval-compressed cycle (with G-CSF support)
renal function and urinalysis for hematuria (ifosfamide/cyclophosphamide with mesna)
cumulative anthracycline dose tracking (DOXOrubicin) and LVEF

doseModificationRules.text: Hold ifosfamide and manage supportively (consider methylene blue per protocol); obtain clinical review before rechallenge.
Hold and intensify mesna and hydration; obtain clinical review.

doseModificationRules.condition: cumulative doxorubicin approaching 450 mg/m2 (warn) or 550 mg/m2 (hard)
doseModificationRules.text: Warn at 450 mg/m2 and stop at the 550 mg/m2 hard cap; reassess cardiac function.
Reduce or hold per severity and clinical review; respect the 2 mg per-dose cap.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Ewing sarcoma chapter (VDC alternating with IE; addition of IE to VDC improved outcomes in localized disease; interval-compressed VDC/IE every 2 weeks established as standard), line 221792 to 221823; per-drug milligram doses not printed in the provided extract

guideline.locator: Ewing Sarcoma Systemic Therapy (EW): VDC-IE (Vincristine/Doxorubicin/Cyclophosphamide/Mesna alternating with Ifosfamide/Mesna/Etoposide), category 1 (line 1324 to 1327)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for VDC/IE (vinCRIStine, DOXOrubicin, cyclophosphamide with mesna, alternating with ifosfamide, mesna, and etoposide) in Ewing sarcoma (StewardMD reference disease ewing_sarcoma). The regimen identity, five-drug alternating composition, and category 1 status are grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Bone Cancer v1.2027, Ewing Sarcoma Systemic Therapy (line 1324 to 1327). The interval-compressed schedule (VDC and IE cycles alternating every 2 weeks, cycleLengthDays 14) is grounded to DeVita 12th ed. line 221819 to 221823, which established interval-compressed VDC/IE as the standard approach. The provided sources name the regimen but do NOT print the per-drug milligram doses, multi-day schedules, or the total cycle count, so every dose field plus cycles are set to the literal VERIFY and listed in verifyFields rather than invented. Safety scaffolding is retained around the unresolved doses: vinCRIStine 2 mg per-dose cap (IV only, never intrathecal); mandatory mesna uroprotection with both the cyclophosphamide and ifosfamide cycles; ifosfamide encephalopathy monitoring; and the conventional anthracycline cumulative cap (warn 450, hard 550 mg/m2). ISMP tall-man applied (vinCRIStine, DOXOrubicin). Status is DRAFT with unresolved VERIFY fields. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
